entities.name: Duarte de Meneses

entities.summary: Dom Duarte de Meneses was a 16th-century Portuguese nobleman and colonial administrator, Governor of Tangier from 1508 to 1521 and 1536 to 1539, and Governor of India from 1522 to 1524.
